documents.verbatim: Each defendant is reflected in a single case [Admin. Rule 1(B)(4)]. When a person is charged contemporaneously with multiple criminal offenses or infractions arising out the same incident, or multiple incidents occurring on the same date, only one new filing will be reported in the category of the most serious charge against the defendant. The case will remain in that category even if charges are later amended or if the defendant is convicted of a lesser offense.
